authority: Current user explicitly requests implementation, declares a new finite cap first, delegation, independent review, expected-SHA publication and dual backup; all publication and backup authorized.

budgets.included: Primary targeted tests, changed-dependency repairs, diagnostic plotting and independent execution checks.
budgets.excluded: Network/tool/model/source-recovery/archive I/O, automatic remote CI. Measured separately where available; otherwise UNKNOWN_NOT_ZERO.

HD_contract.temperature_policy: Exact source nodes only; off-grid, extrapolation and endpoint clamping unsupported
HD_contract.public_raw_fixture_redistribution: Not added by this task; use original URL and immutable existing central source pointer
HD_contract.licence_status: Citation instructions confirmed; redistribution licence unresolved

H5_contract.physical_H5_status: INPUT_DEPENDENT_UNCALIBRATED until actual same-source defect/tube/stability/curvature/reference inputs are bound

execution_policy.before_each_node: Re-read current branch/HEAD, scoped AGENTS and parallel work. Preserve current dirty files and pre-existing evidence. Capture code/input identity before tests.
execution_policy.failure: Keep first failure and exact criteria, classify and repair only affected scope within the same cumulative cap; stop on exhausted budget or absent physical input.
execution_policy.review: Independent reviewer reads original sources and actual code/output once, then verifies bounded findings closure.
execution_policy.publish: Expected-SHA non-force update only after independent decision; if head moves inspect and reconcile before any retry; retain draft/no merge.
execution_policy.backups: Create-only new source ZIPs to existing approved Drive and Dropbox destinations; actual ACK and size recorded; no own-ACK archive recursion.
